reviewedSourceSemantics: Horizontal runs keep their maximum-gap and coverage limits, while gaps greater than five pixels now require observed red/green color in every missing column within y plus or minus four. The condition is a stricter association gate, not evidence inferred from one unrelated colored point.

The orthogonal vertical-edge scan, endpoint grouping and rectangle generation remain unchanged. Both top and bottom additionally require an observed strong horizontal band at that exact row, spanning to within the existing edge-search neighborhood of the measured sides.

Only missing, already measured outer border rows complement the legacy sampler. Every returned interior row remains in the complete sequence before the unchanged minimum-row and uniform-pitch checks. No synthetic interior rule or chosen regular subset is added.
Candle count/span, blank-gutter, stacked price-series, common-baseline volume, competing price-panel and axis-column ambiguity checks remain active. Source pixels are read without mutation.

The new bridge loop examines at most nine neighboring rows for each missing column in each of three contrast bands; it introduces no new unbounded pair search. The original four-million-pixel, horizontal-run, rectangle, candle and colored-component budgets remain unchanged.

No model ROI, case identity, reference coordinates, OCR prices, reference calibration or image-specific geometry enters the detector. No legacy grid/candle reader, OCR/axis fit policy, scale/unit conversion, semantic authority or one-original-pixel acceptance tolerance was changed.
